name: Luesma (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue serrated triangle from the hoist, charged with a shield of the bars of Aragon between two flowering plants.
history: Municipal flag of Luesma; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: serrated triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex towards the fly
small shield of the bars of Aragon
two flowering plants flanking the shield
